annotations.text:
Same screen, four directions.
All daylight, all with real character archetypes — tourist, businessman, shopper.
Pick one and I'll build it into the game.

A — SUNNY PLAZA
Flat vector, warm Mediterranean midday.
Safest broad appeal, reads instantly at speed.
Tradeoff: pleasant but not memorable.

B — BOLD TOON
Thick outlines, saturated, big-headed cast.
Best for ad creative and small screens; the look publishers greenlight most.
Tradeoff: crowded aesthetic, many games look like this.

C — RIVIERA DECO
Mid-century travel poster: limited palette, geometric cast, paper grain, long shadows.
Most distinctive and most premium-feeling.
Tradeoff: narrower appeal, hardest to keep readable at speed.

D — SOFT DIORAMA
Soft-shaded clay toys, gentle daylight, tactile depth.
Highest perceived production value.
Tradeoff: most expensive to build and to keep fast on older phones.
